scope.name: session
scope.summary: The session list and session names.

effect.name: read
effect.summary: Changes no state. The command is not written to the decision log and has no operation receipt.

effect.name: write
effect.summary: Changes state. The command is written to the decision log.

effect.name: destructive
effect.summary: Deletes data. The command is written to the decision log and its input needs `confirm: true`.

idempotency.name: natural
idempotency.summary: The same input gives the same state. Sending it again is safe.

idempotency.name: keyed
idempotency.summary: Sending it again runs it again. Send `idempotency_key` so that the kernel tells a resend apart.

methods.name: akra/kernel/attach
methods.summary: Attach this connection to the kernel of the repository that owns the workspace folder.

methods.name: akra/kernel/command
methods.summary: Send one command. The answer carries the rejection, if any, and the operation receipt.

methods.name: akra/kernel/query
methods.summary: Read one current value or a page of the decision log.

methods.name: akra/kernel/event
methods.summary: Notification from the kernel to an attached client.

methods.name: akra/kernel/detach
methods.summary: Detach this connection. No event arrives after the answer.

commands.name: load_sessions
commands.summary: Load the session list of the workspace. The result arrives as the `sessions` event.

commands.name: submit_prompt
commands.summary: Send a prompt to a thread. The kernel prepares it with planning context and submits a turn. Progress arrives as `prompt_submission` events.

commands.name: steer_turn
commands.summary: Add a prompt to the turn that is running on a thread.

commands.name: stop_all
commands.summary: Request a stop of every running turn.

commands.name: decide_approval
commands.summary: Accept or decline a pending approval request.

commands.name: set_auto_follow_max_turns
commands.summary: Set how many automatic follow-up turns may run after a manual turn.

commands.name: reset_planning
commands.summary: Delete planning data (the queue, the directions, or all of it).

commands.name: refresh_planning
commands.summary: Read the planning queue again. The result arrives as the `planning` event.

queries.name: sessions
queries.summary: The session list of the workspace and its load state.

queries.name: auto_follow
queries.summary: The automatic follow-up settings. They are the same for every thread.

queries.name: thread_activity
queries.summary: The threads that still have work: a running turn, a pending approval, or automatic follow-up.

queries.name: parallel
queries.summary: The parallel mode state: pool, agents, merge queue, and pull request validation.

queries.name: history
queries.summary: A page of the decision log after a cursor. Send the answer's `next_after` as the next `after`.

events.name: sessions
events.summary: The session list or its load state changed.

events.name: thread_activity
events.summary: The set of threads with work changed. The event carries every such thread.

events.name: prompt_submission
events.summary: Progress of a `submit_prompt` command: preparing, submitted, queued, rejected, or failed.

events.name: resync
events.summary: Events for this client were dropped. Read the current values with queries and `history` after the last sequence seen.

events.name: recorded
events.summary: The kernel wrote one decision record. `sequence` is the cursor for `history`.

records.name: thread_prompt_queued
records.summary: The kernel kept a prepared prompt in its queue. It submits the prompt once when it is idle.

records.name: thread_prompt_settled
records.summary: A queued prompt ended: submitted, handed to parallel slots, dropped because its task finished, or rejected again.

records.name: thread_prompt_rejected
records.summary: The kernel rejected a thread prompt before preparation. No planning task was made.

records.name: turn_submitted
records.summary: The kernel accepted a turn submission (manual, prepared, or automatic follow-up).

records.name: turn_ended
records.summary: A turn ended. `outcome` is present when the kernel saw how it ended.

records.name: post_turn_routed
records.summary: The kernel chose what follows a completed turn.

records.name: approval_requested
records.summary: A turn asked for an approval. The request content is not recorded.

records.name: approval_resolved
records.summary: An approval ended: accepted, declined, timed out, withdrawn, or lost at a kernel restart.

records.name: command_received
records.summary: The kernel received a client command. `op_id` is the sequence of this record.

records.name: command_rejected
records.summary: The kernel rejected a received command at once.

reasons.name: steer_in_flight
reasons.summary: Another steer for the same turn is still in flight. Send again with a new idempotency key after it ends.

reasons.name: no_matching_turn
reasons.summary: The thread has no running turn with `expected_turn_id`. Read `active_turn_id` from `thread_activity`.

reasons.name: decision_in_flight
reasons.summary: A decision for the same approval is still in flight.

reasons.name: no_matching_approval
reasons.summary: No pending approval has that id. Read `approval` from `thread_activity`.

reasons.name: busy
reasons.summary: A turn is running or the thread still has work. Send again with a new idempotency key when `thread_activity` is empty.

reasons.name: preparation_active
reasons.summary: Another prompt is being prepared. Send again with a new idempotency key after that preparation ends.

reasons.name: unknown_thread
reasons.summary: The kernel does not know the thread. Send `load_sessions` first.

reasons.name: parallel_mode
reasons.summary: Parallel mode is on. The kernel starts no thread prompt until it is off.

reasons.name: parallel_mode_unknown
reasons.summary: The kernel does not know the parallel mode yet. Send again with a new idempotency key shortly.

errors.name: invalid_params
errors.summary: The request does not match the input schema.

errors.name: method_not_found
errors.summary: The method is not an `akra/kernel/*` method of this protocol version.

errors.name: confirmation_required
errors.summary: A destructive command came without `confirm: true`.

errors.name: not_attached
errors.summary: This connection is not attached. Send `akra/kernel/attach` first.

errors.name: kernel_unavailable
errors.summary: The kernel cannot be reached. Another process (a TUI) may run the kernel of that repository, or the kernel stopped.

errors.name: kernel_timeout
errors.summary: The kernel did not answer in time. The command may still run; read the result with a query.

errors.name: idempotency_key_reused
errors.summary: The `idempotency_key` was already used for a different command. Use a new key for each command.

errors.name: idempotency_unavailable
errors.summary: This kernel has no decision log and cannot tell resends apart. The command did not run.
